groups.name: Response Lab APIs
groups.description: Dedicated endpoints for exercising varied status codes, payload shapes, and security outcomes.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Success
endpoints.description: Returns a standard 200 JSON payload for baseline success-path verification.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Created
endpoints.description: Returns a 201 JSON payload with a Location header for resource-creation testing.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Accepted
endpoints.description: Returns a 202 JSON payload that simulates async job acceptance.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Redirect
endpoints.description: Returns a 302 payload with a Location header for redirect-handling tests.

endpoints.name: HTML Showcase
endpoints.description: Returns a browser-friendly HTML document with inline CSS so non-JSON response rendering can be tested.

endpoints.name: XML Showcase
endpoints.description: Returns an application/xml document so XML parsers and content negotiation paths can be verified.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Bad Request
endpoints.description: Returns a typed 400 payload with field-level violations.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Unauthorized
endpoints.description: Returns a typed 401 payload without using the security filter.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Forbidden
endpoints.description: Returns a typed 403 payload for explicit authorization coverage.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Not Found
endpoints.description: Returns a typed 404 payload for missing resource coverage.

endpoints.name: Synthetic Internal Error
endpoints.description: Returns a typed 500 payload for failure-path coverage.

endpoints.name: Admin Only Echo
endpoints.description: Requires the admin authority and can be used to exercise real 401/403 security failures.
